chunks: Zur'ah narrated from Samaanah who said:

I asked him about the divorce of a young boy (who has not yet reached puberty) and his dowry. He said: 'If he divorces according to the Sunnah and places the dowry in its proper place and right, then there is no harm and it is valid.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the divorce of a minor boy who has not yet reached puberty?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling from Samaanah, clarifying that a minor boy’s divorce is valid (*ja'iz*) provided it follows the Sunnah and his dowry is correctly allocated. This highlights the Shia juristic view that while a minor lacks full legal capacity, his marriage can be dissolved by his guardian with proper financial settlement, ensuring the validity of the act despite his pre-puberty status.
